autoFocus.zh-CN: 挂载时是否聚焦第一个输入框。只在用户明确进入验证码输入步骤时开启，页面加载时自动聚焦会让读屏跳过之前的内容。
autoFocus.en-US: Whether the first input receives focus on mount. Turn it on only when the user has explicitly entered the code step, because focusing on page load makes screen readers skip earlier content.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element (`role="group"`).

count.zh-CN: 验证码位数，即输入框的个数。
count.en-US: Number of digits, which is also the number of inputs.

format.zh-CN: 单个字符的格式限制：`number` 只允许数字，`mixed` 允许数字和字母，正则或函数按字符判定，函数返回 `true` 时允许该字符输入。
format.en-US: Format limit for a single character: `number` allows digits only, `mixed` allows digits and letters, and a regular expression or function judges each character, and a function allows the character by returning `true`.

onChange.zh-CN: 内容变化时调用，参数为当前内容的字符串。
onChange.en-US: Called when the content changes, with the current content as a string.

onComplete.zh-CN: 所有位数输入完毕时调用，参数为当前内容的字符串。
onComplete.en-US: Called once every digit is filled, with the current content as a string.

ref.zh-CN: 句柄的引用，通过它调用下方 Methods 中的方法。
ref.en-US: Reference to the handle, through which the methods below are called.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 `large`、`default` 或 `small`。未设置时使用 Input 的默认尺寸。
size.en-US: Input size: `large`, `default` or `small`. Falls back to the default size of Input when omitted.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，传给每个输入框；`error` 时显示错误样式。`Form.PinCode` 会自动注入。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, passed to every input; `error` shows the error style. `Form.PinCode` injects it automatically.

value.zh-CN: 输入框内容。传入即为受控，需配合 onChange 更新。
value.en-US: Input content. Passing it makes the component controlled, so update it in onChange.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦第 `index` 位输入框，光标放在该位字符之后；序号从 0 开始，超出范围时忽略。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input at `index` with the caret after its character; `index` starts from 0 and out-of-range values are ignored.

blur.zh-CN: 移出第 `index` 位输入框的焦点；序号从 0 开始，超出范围时忽略。
blur.en-US: Removes focus from the input at `index`; `index` starts from 0 and out-of-range values are ignored.
